text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by thunderous cheers, King Halo 
expresses gratitude to her Trainer... and 
savors the victory together with them. All 
while rejoicing in having proven her own 
talent.

Afterward, when King Halo returned to the 
waiting room, Kawakami Princess excitedly 
told her that she, too, would win the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen someday.

Hearing words that mirrored her past self, 
King Halo replied, "You should become 
first-class in whatever it is you truly 
wish to be."

And having set her next goal on the Yasuda 
Kinen, King Halo smiled audaciously, 
stating that they were not the kind of 
people to end here.
